description: The bounds of a form and of an answer to it, and the typed refusal codes of the submit and save paths. social-service enforces them (apps/social-service/src/forms/answer-bounds.ts: the DTO validator, `submit`, the save checks) and the fill page announces them before anyone sends (frontend/src/lib/forms/answerBounds.ts: the textarea's `maxlength` and counter, the refusal sentences). Each side's spec asserts its constants equal these, so the two cannot drift apart. `maxQuestions` bounds both the questions a form may hold and the keys of one answer, so every form that can be saved can be answered in full; `maxGridRows` bounds a survey grid's rows at save and the keys of one survey-grid answer; `maxProductGridCells` (rows x columns of the largest priced grid a save accepts, `product-grid-contract.ts`) and `maxProductGridCellKey` (two 36-character ids and `:`) bound the keys of one priced-grid answer, `{ "rowId:colId": quantity }`.
